name: agent-lane
description: The agent-lane skills: motta-intake (notes to spike issues), motta-settle-spike (the owner's decisions to agent-ready issues), motta-dispatch (one worktree build session per ready issue), motta-build-issue (the unattended build playbook) and motta-ship-pr (the gated merge of human-approved PRs). They read vtex-copilot-fse's BOARD.md and run its scripts, so they work inside a checkout of that repo. Copied from vtex-copilot/vtex-copilot-fse@9f2bc10 (dev).
